about: Every Animal Pairs sound and video asset: purpose, prompt, duration, credits and approval status. Only 'approved' files and synthesized fallbacks are bundled. The app is English only.

credit_policy.observed_basis: Batch 1: 10.9 requested seconds billed as 109 account credits.

account_usage_log.after: batch2_interface (12 calls incl. 1 unusable, 12.7 requested s)

credit_policy.note: Account figures come from the ElevenLabs account usage (via the connector) and are authoritative; per-sound 'script_estimate' uses the documented 40 credits/s as a conservative budget.

sounds.name: card_flip
sounds.event: A card turns face up (first or second card)
sounds.prompt: Soft, quick flip of a thick felt-covered playing card turning face up, a single gentle swish, close and dry, no music, no reverb, child-friendly
sounds.approval_note: Batch 1 accepted by the user ('first sound-generation step is complete').

sounds.name: card_close
sounds.event: A mismatched pair turns back face down together
sounds.prompt: Gentle reverse card flip starting immediately: a soft felt-covered card turning face down with a quiet swish, slightly lower and softer than a flip, dry, no music, child-friendly
previous_prompts: Gentle reverse card flip, a soft felt-covered card turning face down, slightly lower and softer than a flip, short and dry, no music, child-friendly
sounds.approval_note: Batch 1 accepted by the user ('first sound-generation step is complete').

sounds.name: pair_match
sounds.event: A matching pair is confirmed
sounds.prompt: Bright two-note chime, cheerful rising major third on a soft glockenspiel, clean and sparkly, short gentle decay, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Batch 1 accepted by the user ('first sound-generation step is complete').

sounds.name: pair_miss
sounds.event: The second card is not a match (quiet, encouraging)
sounds.prompt: Quiet, reassuring two-note soft marimba boop, gently descending, warm and friendly, not sad, not a buzzer, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Batch 1 accepted by the user ('first sound-generation step is complete').

sounds.name: board_complete
sounds.event: The last pair is matched (on the board)
sounds.prompt: Warm celebratory flourish, quick rising harp glissando with soft twinkling bells, joyful and gentle, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Batch 1 accepted by the user ('first sound-generation step is complete').

sounds.name: button_tap
sounds.event: Buttons, choices and navigation
sounds.prompt: A single clear, soft tap on a smooth rounded wooden toy block, gentle and close-up, clearly audible, short pop, no music, child-friendly
previous_prompts: Soft rounded tap, a single gentle muted wooden bubble pop, very short, friendly, no music, child-friendly
sounds.approval_note: Batch 1 accepted by the user ('first sound-generation step is complete').

sounds.name: game_start
sounds.event: A new or resumed round begins
sounds.prompt: Short welcoming cue, three gentle rising notes on a soft music box, bright and friendly, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Batch 1 accepted by the user ('first sound-generation step is complete').

sounds.name: completion_jingle
sounds.event: The Results screen appears
sounds.prompt: Cheerful short ending jingle on xylophone and soft ukulele, happy major key, gentle celebratory finish, child-friendly, no vocals
sounds.approval_note: Batch 1 accepted by the user ('first sound-generation step is complete').

sounds.name: mode_select
sounds.event: Choosing a mode or board size on Setup
sounds.prompt: Soft, playful selection cue: a bouncy two-note wooden marimba blip going up, light and friendly, short and dry, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: back
sounds.event: Going back or home
sounds.prompt: Gentle descending cue: two soft wooden xylophone notes stepping down, calm and friendly, short and dry, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: pause
sounds.event: Opening the pause menu
sounds.prompt: Calm two-note stop: two soft mellow music-box notes, the second one lower, settling and peaceful, short, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: resume
sounds.event: Resuming from the pause menu
sounds.prompt: Light two-note return: two soft bright music-box notes rising, gentle and cheerful, short, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: star_earn
sounds.event: Earning a star (no star system in the game yet)
sounds.prompt: Short sparkling chime: a single soft twinkling star sound with a tiny bell shimmer, gentle and magical, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: badge_reveal
sounds.event: Revealing a badge (no badge system in the game yet)
sounds.prompt: Warm magical reveal: soft rising chimes and a gentle harp sweep blooming into a warm glow, short, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: perfect_round
sounds.event: Finishing a round with no misses
sounds.prompt: Celebratory flourish a little bigger than a normal win: bright rising harp glissando with sparkling bells ending on a soft cheerful chord, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.game_hook: GameSession .completed when attempts == pairs (instead of board_complete)
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: confetti
sounds.event: Confetti on the Results screen
sounds.prompt: Soft paper confetti flutter with a subtle sparkle: a clearly audible light papery rustle of confetti falling, with a faint gentle twinkle, no music, child-friendly
sounds.game_hook: ResultsView, quietly after the jingle starts
previous_prompts: Soft paper confetti flutter with a subtle sparkle: light papery rustle drifting down with a faint gentle twinkle, quiet, no music, child-friendly
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: hint
sounds.event: A hint is shown
sounds.prompt: Quiet, inviting cue: a soft gentle twinkle of two light chime notes, curious and encouraging, very gentle, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: try_again
sounds.event: Encouragement after a miss (overlaps pair_miss; mapping to be decided)
sounds.prompt: Reassuring, encouraging cue: two soft warm marimba notes, gentle and kind, never an error sound, not a buzzer, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).

sounds.name: new_best
sounds.event: A new personal best (no best-score system in the game yet)
sounds.prompt: Bright three-note achievement cue: three cheerful rising glockenspiel notes ending with a small sparkle, short, child-friendly, no voice
sounds.approval_note: Approved by the user (all created sound assets approved).
